lead_responses.what_lead_said: Where did you get the £13,000 figure from?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Based off nearby comparables; only 2 found because the property is unique.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: So even at £13,000 or £10,000, high occupancy...

lead_responses.what_lead_said: I like to look at work from the bottom figures... anything is a bonus on top.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Gave net range £2,500-£14,000 around a £7,000/mo likely case.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: So you're charging me 15%... and I've got the channels charging me as well.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Platforms charge ~15% separately from the 15% management fee.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: In that 15%, do you do the cleaning and the whole thing?

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Am I tied in with your contracts? What's the cooling-off period?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: 6-month fixed term then 3-month notice; listing/photos owned by lead.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Do the photographs belong to you or me?
What vetting do you do on guests? Deposit?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Security deposit ~£200-400, ID check, insurance cover for damage beyond deposit.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: What about insurance or licensing? Council notification?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: No licensing currently required; fire safety recommended; council tax doubles but business rates route recoups it.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: With the furniture we've got, what else can we add for £8,000?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Verbal estimate £6,000-8,000 excluding beds/sofa bed; firmer price after seeing it post-renovation.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Would you do the cleaning? I've got cleaners for my manor.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Happy to talk to lead's cleaners if they integrate with scheduling.
